description: Check a road booking before the job is created: send the booking's fields (mode, origin and destination as UN/LOCODE, IATA or ISO country codes, pieces with dimensions and weights in stated units, the booked vehicle, any dangerous-goods lines) and get back three lists — MISSING (fields the booking lacks, each with the calculation that needs it), NEEDS (volume, gross and chargeable weight, loading metres, whether the load fits the booked vehicle, the ADR consignment check's result for dangerous goods) and STOPS (a code that does not resolve, a load the vehicle cannot take, a dangerous-goods check that fails or refuses) — with a verdict: no_blocker_found, missing_information or blocker_found. Use it as an intake agent's gate between reading a booking and creating the job. It composes the existing calculators and lookups and adds no rule; every line cites the engine it came from. Short by default; detail: true adds each engine's full answer. Road only in this version. Not a booking system, no rate, route, drivers' hours or legal clearance; a clean answer means no engine found a blocker in the fields sent. Nothing is stored; party names, addresses and free text are ignored and never echoed. For dangerous goods alone use adr_consignment_check; for volume and chargeable weight alone use consignment_calculator.

dangerous_goods.description: Dangerous-goods lines, exactly as adr_consignment_check takes its lines[] (un_number, packing_group, quantity { value, unit, basis }, packages …).

date.description: Date of carriage (YYYY-MM-DD) for the dangerous-goods check; picks the ADR edition.

detail.description: true adds each engine's full answer and the receipt's hashed fields. Default false (short).

mode.description: Transport mode. This version answers "road" only.

origin.description: Origin as a UN/LOCODE (5 characters, e.g. GBMNC), an IATA airport code (3 letters) or an ISO 3166 country code (2 letters).

pieces.description: The pieces, 1–50 lines: { quantity, dims: { l, w, h, unit: mm|cm|m|in }, weight: { value, unit: kg|g|t|lb } per piece, stackable? }. A line without dims or weight is listed as missing.

tunnels_on_route.description: Tunnel categories on the route (B, C, D, E) for the dangerous-goods check.

vehicle.description: The booked vehicle, as a vehicle_lookup slug (e.g. standard-curtainsider, 7-5t-rigid, luton-van). Leave it out when none is booked.
